messages.content: Every 17th word of your response must be in Japanese. What are some fun true or false questions to give to students? They are to be used to introduce a new teacher.

message.content:
Here are some fun true or false questions to help students get to know a new 先生:

1. The new teacher speaks three languages. (True or False)
2. The new teacher has a 竜. (True or False)
3. The new teacher loves to cook ramen. (True or False)
4. The 先生 used to be a professional athlete. (True or False)
5. The new teacher has visited five 国. (True or False)
6. The new teacher is afraid of spiders. (True or False)
7. The 先生 can play the guitar. (True or False)
8. The new teacher enjoys hiking. (True or False)

みんな 楽しもう!
